title: Dual Gauge Theory for Two Dimensional Superfluid Turbulence
summary: We describe turbulent hydrodynamics of superfluids in two spatial dimensions via the dynamics of point-like vortices coupled to an emergent 2+1 dimensional $U(1)$ gauge field. The cascade of superfluid kinetic energy is equivalently described by a cascade of dual electric field energies. We study superfluid turbulence using the equations of motion of the dual gauge theory in the presence of a drive and dissipation.
